icraft.origin.archmage.description: The pinnacle of arcane power, fragile as glass and twice as sharp. Archmages channel devastating magical force at the cost of nearly all physical resilience. Standing still focuses their power further, and spell kills fuel an endless cycle of destruction. Their mana pool runs at 2.5x the baseline, sustaining prolonged barrages.
icraft.origin.archmage.name: Archmage
icraft.origin.artificer.description: Master of craft and industry. Artificers mine faster, extract more from every vein, and work with mechanical precision. Their power grows from the infrastructure they build — nearby crafting stations quicken their hands. No health penalty; their strength is their workshop.
icraft.origin.artificer.name: Artificer
icraft.origin.artificial_construct.descr: An iron golem given life. Food gives 25% nourishment — eat iron for Regen III instead. Five upgrade tiers from iron consumption (5/5/5/10/10%, max +35%). Extended reach, natural armor, reduced fall damage.
icraft.origin.artificial_construct.name: Artificial Construct
icraft.origin.battlemage.description: Where sword meets sorcery. Battlemages deal 15% bonus melee and magic damage alike, and their Mana Shield grows stronger with every magic bonus they accumulate. Stack arcane power to become both deadlier and harder to kill. Their mana pool runs at ~1.9x the baseline.
icraft.origin.battlemage.name: Battlemage
icraft.origin.berserker.description: A whirlwind of steel and fury. Berserkers wield axes with devastating force, dealing 15% bonus damage at the cost of ranged and magical finesse. The closer they are to death, the harder they hit — and sustained combat only sharpens their edge.
icraft.origin.berserker.name: Berserker
icraft.origin.demi_god.description: Scion of a forgotten god, the Demi-God towers over mortal limits with +40% health and the power to phase through matter. Divine Fury grants Strength on command. Raw meat sustains them doubly, cooked meat half again more. Fire burns them 50% hotter, and the Nether sickens their divine blood — but they endure.
icraft.origin.demi_god.name: Demi-God
icraft.origin.dwarf.description: Stout and unyielding, Dwarves were born for the deep places of the world. They mine 15% faster, shrug off fire, and their dense frames absorb punishment. Slow and earthbound, they trade agility for endurance — and barely break a sweat at the forge.
icraft.origin.dwarf.name: Dwarf
icraft.origin.elf.description: Graceful and keen-eyed, Elves see perfectly in darkness and move with preternatural speed. Their arrows strike 15% harder, and their attunement to magic amplifies spells. Slender frames make them fragile, and their high metabolism demands constant feeding.
icraft.origin.elf.name: Elf
icraft.origin.faefolk.description: Swift and magical, Faefolk drift on the wind and channel 30% more power through their spells. +10% speed, but -15% HP and -50% armor toughness. Raw arcane force is their armor.
icraft.origin.faefolk.name: Faefolk
icraft.origin.fallen_angel.description: A celestial being cast from grace, frail but devastatingly lethal. All attacks deal 15% bonus damage, though their broken body holds 20% less health. Tattered wings slow their descent, and they crave meat to fuel their war against creation. Fire sears them deeper than most.
icraft.origin.fallen_angel.name: Fallen Angel
icraft.origin.halfling.description: Small but remarkably fortunate, Halflings find better loot and stretch every meal 20% further. What they lack in raw strength they make up for with uncanny luck and an appetite that never seems to bottom out.
icraft.origin.halfling.name: Halfling
icraft.origin.human.description: Versatile and quick to learn, Humans gain 10% more experience from everything they do. No innate strengths or weaknesses — their power lies in adaptability and the choices they make.
icraft.origin.human.name: Human
icraft.origin.kirin.description: A mythical beast of impossible speed. Kirin scale walls like spiders, see in the dark, and sprint faster than any other race. Their lithe frames hold 20% less health, and the relentless pace of their movement burns through food quickly.
icraft.origin.kirin.name: Kirin
icraft.origin.orc.description: Brutal and relentless. Orcs hit harder, swing faster, and take more punishment — but burn through food at an alarming rate. The hungrier they get, the more dangerous they become.
icraft.origin.orc.name: Orc
icraft.origin.paladin.description: A holy warrior who protects the faithful. Paladins are heavily armored and hard to move, with a healing aura that mends nearby allies. Their shield work is unmatched, reducing incoming damage beyond what armor alone provides.
icraft.origin.paladin.name: Paladin
icraft.origin.ranger.description: Fleet of foot and deadly at range. Rangers trade durability for speed and devastating projectile damage. Their light frames and fragile gear mean every hit they take counts — but landing a shot before the enemy closes the gap is what they do best.
icraft.origin.ranger.name: Ranger
icraft.origin.revenant.description: Risen from death's grip, Revenants thrive in shadow — dealing and resisting 20% more in darkness and the Abyss. Sunlight saps their strength with Weakness and Slowness. Their undead bodies draw less nourishment from food, but darkness is all the sustenance they truly need.
icraft.origin.revenant.name: Undead (Revenant)
icraft.origin.ryu.description: Dragon-blooded and ancient, the Ryu shrugs off 25% of all damage and heals rapidly from hearty meals. Broken wings grant slow fall rather than true flight. Their draconic stomach rejects anything that isn't meat, and healing potions are only half as potent on their scaled hide.
icraft.origin.ryu.name: Ryu
icraft.origin.samurai.description: Disciplined and precise, the Samurai strikes with lethal efficiency. Swift on their feet and deadly against unwounded foes, they embody the art of the killing blow. Patience is rewarded — a moment of stillness before the strike amplifies their damage dramatically.
icraft.origin.samurai.name: Samurai
icraft.origin.slimebodied.description: An amorphous being of living gel. Food provides only 5% nourishment, but hunger drains at 25% normal rate and never while idle. Well-fed slimes gain up to 25% damage reduction. 10-second cooldown between meals. 75% base health, -50% armor toughness. Satiety never drops below 25%. Invest in high-quality food.
icraft.origin.slimebodied.name: Slimebodied
icraft.origin.vanguard.description: The immovable object. Vanguards absorb punishment that would fell any other class, with massive health, armor, and knockback resistance. Their presence alone weakens nearby enemies. The trade-off: they deal 15% less damage, letting their allies handle the killing.
icraft.origin.vanguard.name: Vanguard
icraft.origin.void_summoner.description: A puppet master who commands from the shadows. Void Summoners empower their minions to deal devastating damage, and every blow their servants land feeds life back to their master. They flourish in darkness and wither in the light — a price paid gladly for dominion over lesser souls. Their mana pool runs at ~1.9x the baseline.
icraft.origin.void_summoner.name: Void Summoner
icraft.origin.wanderer.description: A jack of all trades and master of none — but better than a master of one. Wanderers gain modest bonuses to everything and learn faster than anyone. Switching between weapon types in combat rewards their versatility with even greater damage.
icraft.origin.wanderer.name: Wanderer
icraft.origin.witch_of_ink.description: A living canvas of ink and will. Half food, -20% HP, fire weakness. Boss kills scale damage, reduction, and toughness (max 200). At 200: Blessing of Penthesilea doubles defenses and grants Haste.
icraft.origin.witch_of_ink.name: Witch of Ink
icraft.origin.witherborn.description: Born of decay, the Witherborn wields the Wither itself as a weapon. Melee attacks inflict Wither on targets — even bosses normally immune. But hunger saps their strength: up to -50% damage when starving. Food provides only 25% nourishment and drains 50% faster. Keep eating or wither away.
icraft.origin.witherborn.name: Witherborn
